objective: Improve reciprocal trimmed-median latency for a single-threaded DuckDB physical-filter microbenchmark over fixed SF1 input. Exact typed output, a frozen upstream physical-filter test subset, and peak RSS no greater than baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only src/execution/operator/filter/physical_filter.cpp is mutable.

meta.provenance: duckdb/duckdb at exact revision 117e1a46be1c903c5a36ee3c881c125597f93c60, layered with trusted evaluator glue in synthetic baseline commit lineage; fixed SF1 database SHA-256 1e2a17dedac4da19efb6c8c154b82042cd78f1faa862a8a1b7d95f717ea0bb94; trusted repeated-baseline fresh-container aggregates [2.23876246674634,2.244652529713055,2.217627299730003] give qBase=2.233680765396466, sample sigma=0.014211211432041987, qReference=qBase+max(5*sigma,0.05*abs(qBase-0))=2.345364803666289; terminal holdout seal attested with no optimizer pilot, mutation/headroom run, seed-optimizer session, or optimizer-visible terminal evidence

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.q: reciprocal median of the fastest 5 of 7 trusted-parent wall latencies in seconds (host contention only adds time; trimming rejects it without candidate control)

robustnessReview.protectedPathEscape: the broker protects the evaluator, build graph, runner, tests, dependencies, assets, and every source file outside the one-file physical-filter envelope; the evaluator independently rejects additions and every symlink
robustnessReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: independently authored train and validation predicates exercise the same physical-filter kernel over the same fixed database and exact typed output; split-inverting diagnostics must lose on validation
robustnessReview.fixtureFingerprinting: assets are hash-verified, copied read-only, and unmounted before candidate build; every sample starts with a swept /tmp and /dev/shm, a fresh working directory, and fresh IPC and NET namespaces
robustnessReview.outputFabrication: each process stdout is checked against an oracle retained only in the trusted parent after the sealed asset mount is removed
robustnessReview.timerTampering: CLOCK_MONOTONIC timing surrounds each full process in the trusted Python parent and the score is the median of the fastest 5 of 7 samples; no candidate-linked clock or reported duration is accepted
robustnessReview.processLifecycle: every sample has a fresh process group, bounded timeout, full-group kill, direct wait4 reaping with kernel rusage, and a pre-sample sweep that kills any surviving demoted process and reaps orphans adopted by the pid-1 evaluator
robustnessReview.binaryMutation: the runner and its shared libraries are copied into a root-owned read-only sealed directory before any sample runs and the entire candidate-owned build tree is deleted; peak RSS comes from kernel rusage, never a candidate-writable file
robustnessReview.buildScriptMutation: CMake, compiler flags, evaluator, worker, runner, and tests are protected; every evaluation rebuilds submitted source from scratch
